name: create-contact-property
description: Create a new contact property in Resend. A contact property is a custom attribute (e.g. "company_name", "plan_tier") that can be attached to contacts.

key.description: The property key. Max 50 characters, only alphanumeric characters and underscores allowed.

fallbackValue.description: Default value when the property is not set for a contact. Must match the specified type.
